summary_en: TX1 Corporation submitted an amended public tender offer filing for ProjectHoldings, Inc. (TSE Growth, code 9246) on October 9, 2026, following approval of the Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Control Act waiting period shortening on October 5, 2026. The acquisition became possible from October 6, 2026.
title_en: (Amendment) Notice of Amendment Regarding Notice of Commencement of Public Tender Offer for Shares of ProjectHoldings, Inc. (Securities Code: 9246) by TX1 Corporation, in connection with submission of amended public tender offer filing
translation_en_brief:
TX1 Corporation filed an amended public tender offer filing on October 9, 2026, for ProjectHoldings, Inc., listed on the TSE Growth market (code 9246). This amendment was necessary following correction of certain matters in the original filing dated September 29, 2026, and the subsequent correction filed on October 6, 2026.

The Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Control Act (FECA) waiting period was shortened by approval dated October 5, 2026, enabling TX1 to commence acquisition of ProjectHoldings shares from October 6, 2026. Originally, TX1 had filed FECA notifications on September 18, 2026, with the Ministry of Finance and relevant regulatory authorities via the Bank of Japan, which had been accepted. The standard 30-day waiting period could have been extended up to five months if the transaction was deemed to involve inward direct investment affecting national security, but the shortening approval eliminated this extended waiting period.

The disclosure is an amendment notification addressing technical corrections to the public tender offer filing to reflect the changed regulatory timeline, with underlined portions indicating specific amendments. Full details of the amended terms, including purchase price, number of shares targeted, and offer period, remain as previously disclosed in the September 28, 2026 notice and subsequent October 6 amendment.
